trigger: Chapter start. Fallout rain. Braith digs out his Air Force mask (sets has_gas_mask via hooks).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: January. The rain is grey and leaves grit on the windowsill. The dosimeter Augie gave you ticks like a cheap watch.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Your deployment bag, bottom of the closet. Under the flight suit: your old Air Force gas mask, still in its pouch.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Filters screw in here. One mask. One.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Then I wear a wet towel and stay inside, and you wear the mask and go out. That's not chivalry, it's logistics.

choices.text: We find you a mask. First thing.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Second thing. First thing is sealing this house. Plastic, tape, everything.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Good. Now seal the house. Plastic, tape, every window. Before the next rain.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Sneezing at the grit on her nose. Pawing at it. Looking at you like you can fix the sky.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: FILTER and SEAL are now on the HUD. Filters run out. Seals break. Neither forgives.
